Synopsis:
Dribbles the clown (actually a doppelganger who stole the identity of the famous clown) is on a stage with Buddy the dog beside him. A large crowd looks on. In this scene, Dribbles invites the player on the stage. Player can 1) approach the stage 2) tell a companion to get up on stage or 3) refuse - in which case a fan will volunteer. At the end of the scene, Buddy the dog attempts to sneak up on whoever is on stage and attacks.

Cluster Contexts:
- WYR_Circus_Clown_PreShow.json: Dribbles is presenting himself as a beloved clown on a small stage — in truth a doppelganger who has stolen the famous clown’s identity — with Buddy the dog at his side and a crowd (including children) pressed up front. In the scene Dribbles cheerfully invites the player up: the player can go onstage, send a companion up, or refuse (in which case an eager fan from the crowd will volunteer). Off‑screen, this performance is happening amid the tense Emerald Grove situation (refugees, trainees and weary trainers like Asharak, and druids preparing rituals may be nearby), so who goes up and how people react can carry extra weight. Dribbles’s bubbly patter and Buddy’s silly lines mask something darker — Buddy suddenly attempts to sneak up and attack whoever ends up on the stage.
- WYR_Circus_Clown_PreShow_Companions.json: Companion going on the stage branch of the WYR_Circus_Clown_PreShow dialog, which was cut to this separate dialog for the better cine maintenance. After the player picks a companion in the original dialog this one starts, where we see companion climbing on the stage and after a short line from Dribbles his beast attacks the character.
- WYR_Circus_Clown.json: Main dialogue for the Dribbles the Clown, who in reality is a disguised doppelganger serving the Bhaalists. The player may trigger it by using stealth and approaching the stage from behind.
- WYR_Circus_DressingRoomWorker.json: A one-liner dialog with a circus worker in the dressing room. She watches Dribbles performing on the stage.
- WYR_Circus_Thug_02.json: Dialog with the thug - Dribbles-doppelganger associate. Stands near the animal cages. Probably just a one-liner.

context: Dribbles is presenting himself as a beloved clown on a small stage, but he’s actually a doppelganger who stole the famous clown’s identity (and is tied to darker Bhaalist schemes). He’s accompanied by Buddy the dog and a crowd — including children — pressed up front; Dribbles’s over‑the‑top pantomime hides his true nature. The player can accept his invitation to go onstage, tell a companion to take the spot (which triggers a companion‑specific sequence), or refuse, in which case an eager fan from the crowd will volunteer. Off‑screen this is happening amid the tense Emerald Grove situation (refugees, trainees and druids nearby), and Buddy — who initially seems silly — will suddenly try to sneak up and attack whoever ends up onstage.
